name: Summit AZ - Local Pages SEO Audit 2026-09-02
body:
> Audit · Summit Az · 2026-09-02

# Summary
Audit of the 122 live local pages (12 services x 10 cities, plus Orangeburg Mesa and Mesa FAQs) using a live crawl, the raw WordPress render, the sitemap, GSC (Jul 1 to Aug 31) and GBP. Headline: the pages were technically clean; the problem was performance (2 clicks in two months, 70 pages with zero impressions).

# Key findings
1. Near-duplicate city pages (doorway risk): 41 pages shared 50%+ body text with a sister page, 19 shared 70%+, 4 pairs were 96 to 98% identical (water heater FH vs STV; water softener Phoenix vs Scottsdale vs QC; general plumbing Chandler vs Mesa; drain FH vs Tempe). Worst families: leak detection, softeners, drain, fixtures, water pressure. Sewer, emergency, pipe lining and disposal were well localized.
2. 49 titles over 65 characters due to the brand suffix pattern.
3. Four different phone numbers in schema (on-page default, an OTTO knowledge-graph number on 100 pages, a stray number on 5 pages, and the GBP number). Each page emitted 2 to 5 LocalBusiness-type blocks.
4. Duplicate FAQPage schema on 64 pages (OTTO block plus per-item Elementor schema).

# Action plan (`Summit-AZ-Local-Pages-Action-Plan-2026-09-02.md`)
1. One FAQPage per page: DONE Sep 2. All 112 FAQ pages now emit one block from the `summit-location-seo` mu-plugin; 68 pages got the older localized Q&A set Kim chose. Open: Scott to patch the plugin to clear `_summit_faqs_cache` on Elementor save.
2. Shorten 49 long titles. 3. Missing CTAs, og:image and an H1 typo. 4. Rewrite the 11 near-duplicate pairs. 5. Localize the weak service groups. 6. Request indexing after rewrites. 7. Consolidate LocalBusiness schema.
- Phone conflict skipped on Kim's call (numbers are dynamic GHL pool numbers).

# Data files folded in
- `Summit-AZ-Local-Pages-SEO-Audit-2026-09-02.csv`: one row per page with all flags.
- `Summit-AZ-Local-Pages-FAQ-Backup-2026-09-02.csv`: backup of about 1,200 FAQ Q&A rows before the FAQ consolidation.
- `Summit-AZ-Local-Pages-OTTO-Meta-2026-09-02.csv`: deployed vs dashboard OTTO titles, metas and keywords for 122 pages.
- `Summit-AZ-FAQ-Updated-Pages-2026-09-02.md`: list of the 68 pages whose FAQs were replaced, grouped by service.
- `Summit-AZ-City-Duplication-2026-09-11.csv`: later similarity scores per city page (max similarity and closest sibling).
